findings.expected: either a catalog that activates the record templates, or an explicit understanding that record() is unavailable here
findings.message: record reference routes were not evaluated: no record template is available in this catalog
findings.next_action: no action if this deployment intentionally does not use record(); otherwise activate the modules that own the record subtypes
findings.why: The record templates need their target subtypes (agent_memory and friends) in the active catalog. With none available this check examined zero fields, so a clean result here says nothing about the deployment.
